entities.summary: Cubatão is a city in the state of São Paulo, Brazil, 12 kilometers away from Santos seaport, the largest in Latin America. It is part of the Metropolitan Region of the Baixada Santista. The population is 131,626 in an area of 142.88 km2. It hosts industries, refining oil, steel mills and fertilizers.
